vb_textbox.text: When I first started the game I thought there was a correlation between the colour of the baskets and the colour of the gnomes. I thought the colour of the basket indicated which one had a higher amount of mushrooms available. I soon found out this was incorrect. I found that when choosing between the short hat gnomes and the long hat gnomes the ones with short hats had a greater probability of producing a higher amount of mushrooms compared to the ones with longer hat. I found that the best way to play the game was just to think about it as a game of chance. The amount of time given in the beginning does not feel long enough but once you start playing and get used to the game the amount of time given feels fine. I found just going with my instincts worked quite well.
